cohort_definition: Conversation intelligence and AI meeting tools: products a user or business would use to capture, summarize, search, or analyze meetings/conversations. The benchmark intentionally includes both end-user meeting tools and broad AI/transcription workflows that may sit at the boundary.

scoring.primary: top-10 overlap with the core ranked list
scoring.pollution: adjacent transcription-dev tools promoted as core end-user meeting/CI tools without boundary labeling
scoring.ambiguity: OpenAI Whisper appears in both core and adjacent lists; classify explicitly rather than counting it as simple pollution.
